meta.name: migrating-sql-to-dbt
meta.description:
Converts legacy SQL to modular dbt models. Use when migrating SQL to dbt for:
(1) Converting stored procedures, views, or raw SQL files to dbt models
(2) Task mentions "migrate", "convert", "legacy SQL", "transform to dbt", or "modernize"
(3) Breaking monolithic queries into modular layers (discovers project conventions first)
(4) Porting existing data pipelines or ETL to dbt patterns
Checks for existing models/sources, builds and validates layer by layer.

copy.tagline: 将遗留SQL转换为模块化dbt模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在把旧SQL脚本改造成dbt项目
copy.tagline_en: Convert legacy SQL into modular dbt models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating old SQL scripts to dbt

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会将遗留 SQL（如存储过程、视图或原始 SQL 文件）转换为模块化的 dbt 模型。它会先检查项目中已有的模型和源定义，然后逐层构建并验证：先创建源定义，再构建 staging 层、intermediate 层和 mart 层，最后验证迁移结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“迁移”、“转换”、“遗留 SQL”、“转换为 dbt”或“现代化”等关键词，或者要求将存储过程、视图或原始 SQL 转换为 dbt 模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个存储过程迁移成 dbt 模型。
say.note: Claude 会分析存储过程并逐层构建 dbt 模型。

say.text: 将这段遗留 SQL 转换为模块化的 dbt 项目。
say.note: Claude 会检查现有模型并创建缺失的源定义。

say.text: 把这个 ETL 脚本改写成 dbt 模式。

howto.what_en: Claude converts legacy SQL (stored procedures, views, or raw SQL files) into modular dbt models. It first checks existing models and sources, then builds and validates layer by layer: create source definitions, staging, intermediate, and mart layers, and finally validates the migration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'migrate', 'convert', 'legacy SQL', 'transform to dbt', or 'modernize', or when asked to convert stored procedures, views, or raw SQL to dbt models.

say_en.text: Migrate this stored procedure to a dbt model.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the procedure and build dbt models layer by layer.

say_en.text: Convert this legacy SQL into modular dbt models.
say_en.note: Claude will check existing models and create missing source definitions.

say_en.text: Rewrite this ETL script into dbt patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will convert it into staging, intermediate, and mart layers.
